summary.text: On Dominaria, Karn discovers a Phyrexian staging ground beneath a sealed Thran workshop, where Sheoldred hangs suspended, and he is buried by a cave-in as the only one who knows she is on the plane.

When he is dug out, he and Ajani warn the summit leaders that the Phyrexians have returned, but sleeper agents hide among the people they trust, and Karn and his allies form a New Coalition to force the Phyrexians into open war.

Across Dominaria, from Shiv and Yavimaya to Femeref, the invasion spreads with horrors such as the corrupted Weatherlight, and the story builds toward the Battle of the Mana Rig against Sheoldred's army.
